item.description:
Britain's Marc 'Caedrel' Lamont and Dan Gaskin were among the winners at the 2026 Esports Awards in Miami, where Counter-Strike 2 was named game of the year and Team Vitality and BLAST also took industry honours. item.title: Bilibili Gaming beat all four LCK teams to win Worlds 2026 and end Korean title run
item.description:
Bilibili Gaming beat Gen.G in Brooklyn to win the 2026 League of Legends World Championship, the LPL's first world title since 2021. Added to their First Stand trophy, the result gives a Chinese side a double that no team had managed since 2016, just as Riot takes the 2027 season opener to China.

The post Bilibili Gaming beat all four LCK teams to win Worlds 2026 and end Korean title run appeared first on Esports Insider.

item.title: MSI 2027 heads to Valencia as Riot reshapes Split 1 with First Stand: All In in China
item.description:
Riot will take the Mid-Season Invitational to Spain in 2027, bringing a top-tier League of Legends event back to Europe for the first time since the Worlds 2024 final in London. Its one-off, expanded First Stand in China will also change Split 1 for the LEC, with the full details due in January.
